# MCPJam Inspector

- [MCPJam Docs](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/index.md): Test, debug, and evaluate MCP servers, MCP apps, and ChatGPT apps across every major AI client.\n- [Get
ting Started](https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md): Start testing your MCP server in minutes\n- [Installation](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/installation.md): Here's a list of all ways to start MCPJam\n- [Hosted App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/overview.md
): Use MCPJam Inspector in the browser, no installation required\n- [MCPJam in Claude](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/claude-conne
ctor.md): Connect Claude to your MCPJam account through the hosted MCP server: projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing\n-
[Okta SSO & SCIM](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/sso.md): Install MCPJam from the Okta Integration Network and configure SAML sin
gle sign-on and SCIM provisioning\n- [IP Allowlisting](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/network.md): The addresses hosted MCPJam con
nects from, for firewalls and IP allowlists on your MCP and OAuth servers\n- [Common MCP Errors](https://docs.mcpjam.com/troublesh
ooting/common-errors.md): Solutions to common MCP server connection and configuration issues\n- [Error code reference](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md): What every MCPJam Inspector error code means, the likely causes, and the next step t
o fix it.\n- [Changelog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/changelog/overview.md): Track the latest updates, features, and improvements to M
CPJam Inspector\n- [Home](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/home.md): Org-scoped dashboard with activity stats, recommended server
s, and quick-start clients\n- [Clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/clients.md): Reusable MCP client configurations for test
ing servers and apps under realistic conditions\n- [Multi-server connections](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/connecting-servers
.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers with different transport methods\n- [Projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/projects.md
): Group your MCP servers into projects, with the ability to share them with your team\n- [MCP protocol versions](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/inspector/protocol-versions.md): Pin the inspector to a specific MCP protocol version, including the 2026-07-28 stateless
RC, to test how your server behaves across versions.\n- [Host Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-compat.md): Se
e which hosts your MCP server will work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot) the moment you connect\n- [Skills](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/inspector/skills.md): Load and use skills to give your agents the context they need to use MCP tools effectively\n- [Playgr
ound](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand, render widgets, and insp
